children: EQUINOR AND PTT INTERNATIONAL TRADING PTE LTD (PTTT) HAVE SIGNED A LONG-TERM AGREEMENT FOR THE SUPPLY OF LIQUEFIED NATURAL GAS (LNG)
AGREEMENT IS THE FIRST LONG-TERM LNG AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE TWO COMPANIES
COMMERCIAL TERMS OF THE AGREEMENT ARE CONFIDENTIAL BETWEEN THE PARTIES
